testCases.scenario: Create new product with initial effective price
testCases.expectedResult: Product saved in Active list and initial price recorded
testCases.actualResult: Product AD0005 created and displayed with $120.00 active price

testCases.scenario: Add newer effective price and verify historical price retention
testCases.expectedResult: Latest effective date resolves as active price while older entry remains in history
testCases.actualResult: Active price updated to $150.00; 2026-11-19 ($120.00) preserved in Price History

testCases.scenario: Reject duplicate effective date on the same product
testCases.expectedResult: System blocks duplicate effective date entry with validation error
testCases.actualResult: Duplicate date rejected with validation message
